name: Ototachibana Kanna
source:
Painfully shy and quiet, she’s an unfortunate girl who can’t help but be misunderstood.

She used to be an honest, cheerful child, but for reasons unknown, she can no longer be honest with others—or even with herself.
Surrounded by adults who judge people only by appearances, she’s built walls between herself and those around her,
retreating deeper and deeper into her own shell.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Student
[b]Likes:[/b] Waterfronts, healthy food
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Crowds, confined spaces
[b]Hobby:[/b] Spending time lost in thought alone, playing with cats

[b]"Hey..."[/b]
